title: Tensor pullback preserves quasi-coherence on ringed spaces
statement: Let $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be any morphism of ringed spaces [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. The concrete tensor pullback $\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}g^{-1}G$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. This uses the shared sheaf module carrier [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with no flatness or finite-presentation assumption.

proof.text: Use the local quasi-coherence theorem at each x : X to choose an open U x containing x on which the tensor pullback restricted over U x is quasi-coherent.
The chosen opens cover X because each x belongs to U x. Apply SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop to conclude that the tensor pullback is quasi-coherent globally.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Tag 01BG, Lemma 17.10.4; formal proof via local-cover criterion

mathlib_searches.query: Pullback of a quasi coherent sheaf of modules along a morphism of ringed spaces is quasi coherent
Pullback along a ringed space morphism preserves locally presented quasi coherent modules
mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.pullback and finite-presentation quasicoherence declarations; no generic ringed-space tensor-pullback preservation theorem.

No hits in Mathlib. WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Tilde.isQuasicoherent_pullback applies only to scheme morphisms; the source ringed space here need not be a scheme. Presentation.map is useful for the local proof but does not identify restriction of the concrete tensor pullback.

from.place: Modules, Tag 01BG, Lemma 17.10.4, proof; local presentation argument for underived tensor pullback

theorem tensorModulePullback_isQuasicoherent
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherent) :
    (SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
      (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
      (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf G)).IsQuasicoherent
